profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Adaptable software engineer with 20 years of experience delivering high-performance full-stack applications in fast-paced enterprise environments. Expert at aligning frontend innovation (React, TypeScript) with robust backend systems (Node.js, .NET) to engineer scalable, seamless digital solutions.

positions.title: Independent Software Engineer | Digital Consultant
positions.description:
▪ Deliver end-to-end software solutions including requirements gathering, system architecture, development, testing, and deployment.
▪ Modernize legacy web-based applications by incrementally integrating frontend technologies (React, Next.js, Tailwind), leveraging advanced asynchronous patterns to eliminate rendering bottlenecks and accelerate data-fetching efficiency.
▪ Build responsive, portable themes using official web specifications (HTML, CSS, Javascript) and accessible WCAG standards.
▪ Leverage cloud-scale data warehousing (Google BigQuery, Azure) to process large datasets and build interactive dashboards (Power BI) that transform complex SQL query results into actionable, visual business insights.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · REST APIs · Git · HTML5

positions.title: Senior Front End Engineer
positions.description:
▪ Developed reusable Web Components and UI libraries using React bundled into Java, supporting enterprise design system initiatives.
▪ Increased component reuse by 35% through implementation of Storybook-driven development and standardized UI patterns.
▪ Integrated RESTful APIs to streamline data flow across multiple enterprise applications.
▪ Engaged in active scrum ceremonies—including daily stand-ups and retrospectives—to streamline the deployment of decoupled frontend solutions.

positions.title: Senior Associate Experience Technology L2
positions.description:
▪ Collaborated on frontend development to construct reusable, scalable UI components using React which was then bundled (via Webpack or Maven clientlib generators) for intergration into Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) page templates.
▪ Accelerated team delivery by conducting thorough, sprint-by-sprint code reviews to ensure code quality, architectural consistency, and adherence to best practices.
▪ Coordinated deployments and releases, ensuring stability and compliance for various public sector web applications.
positions.insights: Skills: REST APIs · Git · HTML5 · Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) · Maven · Android/iOS

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
▪ Led the incremental migration of a legacy BackboneJS application to React, optimizing asynchronous programming patterns to improve data-fetching efficiency and user experience.
▪ Architected and deployed enterprise-grade single page application using React (React Router), leveraging Context API to handle state management.
▪ Built responsive, high-fidelity user interfaces by unifying Material-UI (MUI) components with CSS-in-JS for dynamic, state-driven styling, and true component scoping.
▪ Integrated POS systems with hardware peripherals—including printers, card readers, and scanners—utilizing customized firmware to maximize transaction efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · REST APIs · Git · HTML5

positions.title: Web Developer & Designer | Digital Marketing Consultant
positions.description:
▪ Developer, designer and consultant on a range of projects for local events, restaurants and retail stores.
▪ Custom Wordpress theme and plugin development.
▪ Site design, maintenance, and consulting for Inman Park Restaurant Week - a biannual event website visited by thousands of people each year.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
▪ Developed custom WordPress themes and plugins using PHP, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
▪ Collaborated with designers and stakeholders to deliver responsive marketing websites.
▪ Improved development workflows and coding standards across projects.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description: ▪ Custom WordPress themes and plugins development.

positions.title: Web Developer | Email Marketing Specialist
positions.description: ▪ Built and maintained large-scale web properties and email marketing campaigns.

positions.description: ▪ Led all frontend development initiatives and established coding standards for all web-based projects.

positions.title: Front End Web Developer

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
▪ Lead front end programmer and SEO consultant for all in-house projects.
▪ Developed and assemble assets for high profile websites in a collaborative environment.
▪ Managed client obligations throughout the entire production process.
▪ Post-production client support and IT assistance.
▪ Assisted with brand identity and creative marketing techniques to enhance market visibility.
